page.overview:
Who is Mike Joyride?

Mike Joyride is a character in Cars 3. He is voiced by Mike Joy. Joyride is an unseen talk show host who "stays one step ahead in the racing news game by keeping a keen eye on where the racing season is headed". Lightning McQueen listens to Joyride's show in the off-season after his major crash in an attempt to beat Jackson Storm.
